opening: I have pain in my neck and arms.
Both of my hands have become weak, and my grip is weaker.
I've had it for a year.
It's been over the past 3 months.
Along with the pain, I get pins and needles in my hands.
I was in a car accident 3 years ago.

opening.text: I've had burning pain in my neck and arms for a year, and it comes with pins and needles in my hands. Both of my hands have become weak, and my grip is weaker, which has been happening over the past 3 months. I was in a car accident 3 years ago, and I have type 2 diabetes and high blood pressure.
